ITEM PARAGRAPHS
If
you're
dealing
with
bugs
and
the
landlord
isn't
addressing
the
issue
,
there
are
steps
you
can
take
.
You
can
report
the
problem
to
local
government
authorities
,
who
can
send
professionals
to
handle
it
.
Alternatively
,
tenants
have
the
option
to
tackle
the
issue
themselves
with
appropriate
methods
and
tools
.
This
proactive
approach
ensures
that

can
maintain
a
healthy
and
